description: The Envoy External Processor that feeds the audit trail (DEMIS-6253). Every value comes from one sidecar: the audited workload's (ext_proc counters, its requests) or the processor's (the streams it received). Requires meshConfig.defaultConfig.proxyStatsMatcher to include '.*\.ext_proc\..*'. Derived from "load & drops" for several EnvoyFilters per audit-log-service (istio.extProc.filters): the ext_proc stats of the audited workloads carry the filter's stats prefix in the metric name, which is kept as label "filter" so that several prefixes per workload (two filters, or a renamed one) no longer collide.

panels.title: Processor pods ready
Streams at the processor — counted by the processor's sidecar

panels.description:
Streams received by the processor, by how they ended (gRPC status + Envoy response flags of the processor's sidecar).

| Outcome | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| **OK — closed by the processor** (grpc 0, flags -) | The processor got the last expected message and closed the stream. The normal case. | — |
| **not closed by the processor** (DR) | Nobody closed the stream; the audited workload's Envoy reset it, normally when `deferred_close_timeout` expired after the request. | The processor does not recognise the end of the exchange, or reads too slowly — the record may be incomplete. |
| **error** (grpc 2) | The processor ended the stream with an exception, usually a parse error. | Processor log. No record for that request. |
| **cancelled / deadline / internal** (grpc 1 / 4 / 13) | gRPC-level failure inside the processor. | Processor log. |
| **unavailable** (grpc 14) | The processor's sidecar could not reach the processor. | Pod status, restarts. |
| **unreachable** (UC, UF, URX, UH) | Processor container closed, refused or is missing. | Pod status, restarts, readiness. |
| **dropped** (DC) | The connection from the audited sidecar went away mid-stream. | Restarts of the audited workload. |
| **other** | Any combination not listed; the raw values are shown. | Envoy response-flag docs. |

targets.expr: sum by (processor, outcome) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_replace((clamp_min(last_over_time(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) - (istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"} offset $__interval * 1 or last_over_time(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) / ($__interval_ms / 1000)), "processor", "$1", "destination_service_name", "(.*)"), "sig", "/", "grpc_response_status", "response_flags"), "outcome", "other (grpc/flags = $1)", "sig", "(.*)"), "outcome", "OK — closed by the processor", "sig", "0/-"), "outcome", "cancelled (gRPC 1 CANCELLED)", "sig", "1/.*"), "outcome", "error — processor ended the stream (gRPC 2 UNKNOWN)", "sig", "2/.*"), "outcome", "deadline exceeded (gRPC 4)", "sig", "4/.*"), "outcome", "internal error in the processor (gRPC 13 INTERNAL)", "sig", "13/.*"), "outcome", "unavailable (gRPC 14 UNAVAILABLE)", "sig", "14/.*"), "outcome", "unreachable — processor container closed or refused ($1)", "sig", ".*/(UC|UF|URX|UH)"), "outcome", "dropped — connection from the audited sidecar closed (DC)", "sig", ".*/DC"), "outcome", "not closed by the processor — Envoy reset it (DR)", "sig", ".*/DR"))

targets.expr: sum by (processor) (label_replace((clamp_min(last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) - (istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"} offset $__interval * 1 or last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) / ($__interval_ms / 1000)), "processor", "$1", "destination_service_name", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Throughput into the processor

panels.description: Average bytes per stream received by the processor's sidecar (request_bytes_sum / _count).

targets.expr: sum by (processor) (label_replace(clamp_min(last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) - (istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"} offset $__interval * 1 or last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_sum{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0), "processor", "$1", "destination_service_name", "(.*)")) / (sum by (processor) (label_replace(clamp_min(last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_count{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) - (istio_request_bytes_count{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"} offset $__interval * 1 or last_over_time(istio_request_bytes_count{reporter="destination", namespace="$processor_namespace", request_protocol="grpc", destination_service_name=~"${processor:regex}"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0), "processor", "$1", "destination_service_name", "(.*)")) > 0)

panels.title: Bytes per stream

panels.description: Cores. The audited workload's istio-proxy carries the ext_proc client; the processor's two containers carry the stream server.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"(${workload:regex})-.*", container="istio-proxy"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$processor_namespace", pod=~"(${processor:regex})-.*", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Working set against the container memory limit (dashed).

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"(${workload:regex})-.*", container="istio-proxy"})
sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$processor_namespace", pod=~"(${processor:regex})-.*", container!="", container!="POD"})

max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory", pod=~"(${workload:regex})-.*", container="istio-proxy"} or kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$processor_namespace", resource="memory", pod=~"(${processor:regex})-.*"})
